channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Camellia named for Gov. Kay Ivey on Alabama “Camellia Day”
item.description: Greenville Camellia Society officers honored Gov. Kay Ivey, naming a new variety of the state flower for her during a ceremony Wednesday.

item.title: Alabama Farm Center secures $11M for abandoned mine land cleanup
item.description: The $11 million award secured the reclamation of hazardous land, paving the way for up to 850 new jobs and a $2.2 billion boost.

item.title: State auditor race takes shape as Chen qualifies, Sorrell seeks reelection
item.description: With businessman Derek Chen's qualification, the race now pits his call for reform against incumbent Andrew Sorrell's push for continuity.

item.title: Alabama approves $6.48 million in school safety mapping, software contracts
item.description: State legislators approved contracts for a statewide school safety software platform and detailed digital mapping, advancing the 2024 School Security Act.

item.title: “I’m running out of necessity”: Congressional challenger Case Dixon qualifies for GOP primary
item.description: Dixon criticized incumbent Gary Palmer, saying the 12-year incumbent repeatedly failed to stand for accountability and fueled inflation with massive spending votes.

item.title: Sens. Britt, Tuberville vote against advancing Venezuela war powers resolution
item.description: During interviews on conservative shows, Tuberville has repeatedly, boldly claimed that Venezuelan vote-tampering elected “a handful of congressmen and senators.”

item.title: DNC warns Alabama Secretary of State over potential federal voting law violations
item.description: The DNC issued a warning letter to the Alabama secretary of state threatening legal action if the state failed to comply with federal voting laws.

item.title: Opinion | Republicans refused proper oversight of ICE. Now, people are dying
item.description: It was easy to predict what happened in Minneapolis. It's what happens every time we give too much power and too little oversight.

item.title: Alabama Congressional Delegation splits on fatal Minneapolis ICE shooting
item.description: The Alabama delegation split sharply along party lines after an immigration officer fatally shot a woman in Minneapolis, sparking protests across the state.

item.title: Montgomery county leaders: Internet sales tax changes threaten public safety
item.description: County leaders and the sheriff held a press conference Thursday, warning that losing internet sales tax funding would cut 12 deputies from the department.
